scene.note: Your laptop gets a copy of the server's history, and work on it stays on the laptop.

steps.note: The shop's history lives on the server, and your laptop has none.
A clone copies the whole history and every branch into shop.
The copy remembers the server under the name origin.
Wilma's branch is on the server, and your copy remembers where it is.
You make a branch of your own that follows the server's.
It starts at Wilma's commit, with her voucher line.
Wilma says the vouchers do not last forever.
The fix is committed on your branch.
The server does not have it yet: your branch is ahead by one commit.
